amb.amina.1: Check-in is until seven, and questions are welcome anytime.
amb.amina.2: Hi, Hallo, Bonjour — pick whichever feels closest.
amb.luc.1: Pencil behind my ear? Yes, it has lived there for years.
amb.luc.2: Show me where it catches. We will fix it together.
amb.nora.1: Thirty more kilometres, and I will see the sea.
amb.nora.2: After lunch I look for shade, not records.
amb.ingrid.1: The best trails get written in the margins of old maps.
amb.ingrid.2: Has anyone seen my glasses? They were just here.
amb.sarah.1: Over there, above the lake, is my favourite bench.
amb.sarah.2: The group is at four, so tea until then.
amb.claire.1: How is your little one? Eating well?
amb.claire.2: Tail up, ears forward — that is a good sign.
amb.shopper.1: The lantern burns steady, and batteries are at the till.
amb.shopper.2: A tent for two? Take the bigger one, no regrets.

intro.narr1: A rainy night. Matthew is looking for a charger. Look around the room: the lamp, the window, the shelf.
intro.spot.lamp.line: The lamp glows warm, but there is no charger by it.
intro.spot.window.line: Rain outside the glass. No charger on the sill either.
intro.spot.shelf.line: Grandpa's old atlas. And an envelope between the pages.
intro.pick: Who drives us all on the first trip?
intro.george1: If it is the manual for the old vacuum cleaner, then yes.
intro.chaos.george: The plan is simple: forget nothing.
intro.matthew1: Dad, did you know we have a family treasure?
intro.letter.1: George. In case you all ever forget how good it is to simply be together.
intro.letter.2: The best trips don't start with a perfect plan. They start with a decision to go together.
intro.victoria1: First we pick a place. Then we'll save the world from the sock shortage.
cold.title: CampTribe
cold.sub: A story of one rainy autumn
cold.window: Rain, the third evening in a row. On nights like this everyone keeps to their own corner.
cold.family: Dad watches the rain. Mum scrolls the forecast. Matthew digs through the closet for a charger.
cold.atlas: Instead of a charger: Grandpa Henry's old road atlas. A postcard tucked between the pages.
cold.postcard: Evelin, remember the lake in '78? One half is here. The other waits where we promised to return. H+E

ep.title: Chapter 1 · "Plan vs. Reality" · end of episode
ep.recap.night-tent: First night in the tent by the pines. Crooked, but together.
ep.recap.night-car: First night in the car by the pines. Cramped, but dry.
ep.recap.night-gazebo: First night in the gazebo by the water. Wind included for free.
ep.recap.fish-released: The fish from the lake went back. Nora nodded, and that was enough.
ep.recap.fish-kept: The fish from the lake became dinner. A bit charred, but ours.
ep.recap.litter: Someone's litter by the water is gone. Nobody saw, but the lake remembers.
ep.recap.nora: Nora got her help on the shore — and a new acquaintance.
ep.recap.photo: Matthew shot the tent in firelight. A photo nobody will frame, but everyone will keep.
ep.recap.tent: The tent went up. Not on the first try and not straight — but together.
ep.recap.fire: The fire caught from damp wood. George wrote on the list: "damp wood — normal".
ep.recap.home: Back home with sand in the shoes and a plan for the next trip.
ep.trace: Between the atlas pages — a circled hill and a pencil line: "The best view isn't from the tower. H+E".
ep.next: Next episode: Luxembourg, a trail of our own — and the other half of the medallion.
ep2.title: Chapter 2 · "A Trail of Our Own" · end of episode
ep2.recap.forgotten: We took the forgotten trail with Ingrid — along the margins of her old map.
ep2.recap.other: We found another trail ourselves — by the map's hints and Grandpa's note.
ep2.recap.medallion: The two halves of the medallion met without a gap, where three countries meet.
ep2.recap.halves: Both halves of the medallion are in the backpack, and the line from the micro-map leads on.
ep2.recap.wet: The wet tent went into a separate bag. It will dry at home and serve again.
ep2.recap.dry: The dry tent was folded in a minute while Ingrid poured the tea.
ep2.trace: On the micro-map packet, Grandpa's line: "Tarte flambée — baker in Colmar. Go while the oven is hot."
ep2.next: Next episode: Alsace, tarte flambée and a Colmar baker who knows Grandpa's handwriting.
atlas.note.luxembourg: Three countries in one step. The line from the micro-map leads to Alsace.
atlas.lux.title: Luxembourg · Müllerthal
atlas.lux.note: On the micro-map packet — Grandpa's line: "Tarte flambée — at the baker's in Colmar. Go while the oven is hot."
atlas.henry.hint: Pencil marks on the maps: every one can be found, none is required.
sum.tomorrow.1: a campfire by the lake, a starry evening and neighbours with small favours.
sum.tomorrow.2: a last morning by the lake, then the road home.
sum.tomorrow.ch2.1: a trail closed after a landslide, and a choice of where to go next.
sum.tomorrow.ch2.2: three countries, one bottle and the second half of the medallion.
atlas.photos.hint: The phone camera: stand by a spot and press the action - the shot stays here.
photo.orchid: A wild orchid at the forest edge
atlas.orchid.note: Grandfather's note: "Look where the rocks weep on a sunny day."
life.board: Notice board: quiet hours 10 pm to 7 am. Rubbish in the bins, campfire never unattended. Enjoy your stay!
shop.closed: Closed until 08:00. We can go home or wait.
bark.bedtime: Victoria: "Time for bed — early start tomorrow."
bark.sleepAuto: George fell asleep with the map on his face.
atlas.map.title: Our next journeys
atlas.note.lake: Come here. It's good to be quiet together. — H.
atlas.note.label: Grandpa Henry's note
atlas.sentence: Every place you visit becomes a page with a stamp. Collect them, and the road leads to your own camper.
atlas.legend: A page is a place you have been. A stamp is your mark on it.
backpack.title: Backpack
backpack.sellHint: You can sell at the camp reception.
mg.help: A little easier: more time, a wider band, a hint.
mg.ref.title: Three stops
mg.ref.intro: Tap Stop when the marker is in the light band in the middle. Three tries.
mg.ref.hint: The light band in the middle: tap there.
mg.ref.result.fine: Fine: almost everything is in place.
mg.ref.result.scrappy: Scrappy: it came out as it came out, on we go.
ui.drive.etaLate: Reception closes before we get there
ui.drive.waitDry: Waiting for a tow to the pump
ui.drive.fineTaken: Fine — taken from the family money
ui.drive.beat.start: We're off. Forty-two kilometres and we're there.
ui.drive.beat.fields: Yellow fields all the way out. Can I count the turbines?
ui.drive.beat.plan: We have exactly enough fuel. Let's keep it steady.
ui.drive.beat.radio: Radio: wind picking up this evening, a storm likely by night.
ui.drive.beat.cat-calm: Mia is quiet, watching the window like a grown-up.
ui.drive.beat.evening-plan: Simple plan: reception, pitch, tea. Everything else later.
ui.drive.beat.lake: The lake! Over there, between the trees. I saw it first.
ui.drive.beat.sign-camp: Lakeside campsite 4 km. Reception open until 19:00.
ui.drive.beat.camera-sign: Camera sign. I'll ease off, let it take its picture.
ui.drive.beat.fined: There's our souvenir from the road. A pricey one.
ui.drive.beat.close-pass: Cyclist ahead. Let's not squeeze past him, please.
ui.drive.beat.jam: Brake lights all the way to the bend. Lovely.
ui.drive.beat.puncture: A puncture. We have a spare, twenty minutes and we're off.
ui.drive.beat.diversion: Diversion. A few kilometres longer, but the road is whole.
ui.drive.beat.dry-tank: Tank's dry. We'll have to ask for a tow to the pump.
ui.drive.beat.refuel: Full tank. Now we can stop counting every kilometre.
ui.drive.beat.rest: Five minutes on our feet and everyone feels better.
ui.drive.beat.queasy: I'm getting a bit carsick. Can we go smoother?
ui.drive.beat.cat-frets: Mia is scratching at the carrier. She hates all this.
ui.drive.beat.arrived: We're here. Now the important bit: choosing a spot.
mg.drive.title: The drive to the lake
mg.drive.intro: Get the family there on time, calm and without fines. Swipe sideways to change lane.
mg.drive.hint: The free lane is highlighted. Ease off before the camera sign and there is no fine.
mg.drive.result.good: Early and calm: the pick of the pitches is still open.
mg.drive.result.fine: On time: the best pitch is taken, but there is still a choice.
mg.drive.result.scrappy: Late and frazzled: two pitches left. Never mind, you can sleep there too.
ui.drive.beat.castle: Castle ruins on that hill! Can we go there one day?
ui.drive.beat.snacks: Anyone want an apple? Sandwiches only after halfway.
ui.drive.beat.storm-talk: If the storm comes, the tarp goes up first. Before tea.
ui.drive.beat.halfway: Halfway done. Sandwiches are officially allowed.
ui.drive.beat.sheep: Sheep on the slope! One is staring right at us.
ui.drive.beat.clouds: Radio: clouds gathering in the west, the wind is rising.
ui.drive.beat.pines: Smell that? Pine trees. That's our forest now.
ui.drive.beat.almost: Last bend. Hold on, nearly there.
